w.doc: Mean energy per quantum W (PRD Eq. 1); 13.7 eV

field.doc: PandaX-4T drift field. Run0 ~93 V/cm (this default); Run1 ~84 V/cm (override per run). NR yield is weakly field-dependent (~field^0.05).

liquid_xe_density.doc: Liquid xenon density (PRD Eq. A2 varsigma)

p0_nr.doc: P4-NEST NR Legendre coefficient p0 (standard Legendre, xi_norm=150). Refit to digitized Fig. 17 Run0 LY+QY; consistent with PRD Table II [0.7,-1.6,1.3,-0.6] within its uncertainties. Refit reduces the Run0 LY/QY residual from ~2-7% to <0.5%.

p1_nr.doc: P4-NEST NR Legendre coefficient p1 (refit to Fig. 17; Table II -1.6+0.9/-0.7)

p2_nr.doc: P4-NEST NR Legendre coefficient p2 (refit to Fig. 17; Table II 1.3+0.5/-0.7)

p3_nr.doc: P4-NEST NR Legendre coefficient p3 (refit to Fig. 17; Table II -0.6+-0.4)

a_nr.doc: P4-NEST NR recombination-fluctuation scaling A^NR (PRD Table II)

d_nr.doc: P4-NEST NR Run1 recombination shift (0 for Run0; -0.043 for Run1, PRD Table II)
